title: The Read-Only Input
description:
## Fix the Bug: The Read-Only Input

The input is controlled — its `value` is bound to React state. But the field rejects every keystroke. Why?

### Symptoms
- Typing into `#name` does nothing
- The display below the input never updates

### Your Task
Make typing work and see the display update live.

> **Think about it:** when you set `value={something}` on an input, React owns its content on every render. If state never moves, neither does the input. What’s the contract you owe React when you make an input controlled?
